author: Marcus Aurelius
text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.

author: Seneca
text: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.

author: Unknown
text: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.

author: André Gide
text: Trust those who seek the truth; doubt those who say they have found it.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.

author: Verbose Author
text: This is an intentionally verbose excerpt designed to exceed two hundred and fifty characters so that the seed and storage layer is exercised on text bodies that contain repeated clauses, layered ideas, and a punctuation density that mirrors what real source material from essays and novels tends to look like in practice.

author: Anaïs Nin
text: Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.

author: Amelia Earhart
text: The most difficult thing is the decision to act, the rest is merely tenacity.

author: Mark Twain
text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.

author: Rainer Maria Rilke
text: The only journey is the one within.

author: Pablo Picasso
text: Art washes away from the soul the dust of everyday life.
